---
title: Initial Self-Assessment
---

Before we dive in, I'd like to understand where you're coming from and what you're hoping to get out of this course. There are no right answers here — I'm asking because your goals genuinely shape how I teach.

Please answer the following on Brightspace. A sentence or two per question is plenty.

1. Why are you taking this course? (Requirement, interest, both?)
2. Have you worked in an organization — a job, student group, team, volunteer role, family business, etc.? What was that like?
3. What do you hope to learn or be able to do by the end of the semester?
4. Is there anything about organizations or workplaces that you're curious about, confused by, or frustrated with?
5. Is there anything else you'd like me to know about you as a student?
